# VERITAS-AI v0.1.0

This public pre-release is an executable laboratory proof of concept for continuous assurance of an AI-enabled network intrusion classifier. Its evidence is consistent with TRL 3.

The release includes the Python wheel and source distribution, an AMD64 and ARM64 container, safe synthetic PCAP and authentication evidence, real Zeek connection records, the XGBoost model in native JSON, the assurance baseline, six monitoring scenarios, the signed event ledger, its public verification key, an SPDX JSON software bill of materials, SHA-256 checksums, GitHub attestations, and a short reproducible terminal recording.

The software is not an operational security product. It has not been evaluated with a security end user, an external adoption partner, production traffic, or a representative operational environment. It does not demonstrate TRL 6, certification, or operational effectiveness.

See the release assets and documentation site for verification and reproduction instructions.
